description: This is a source HTML file that defines the front-end interface for a database visualization tool, including UI structure, styling, and client-side scripting to fetch and display database, table, and data content dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database to show its tables, and loads tables if expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data from a specific table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and displays the data table with row data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects, long strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long strings or objects.
